literal_meaning: শক্তি বা বলের উপর ভরসা (strength or power's reliance)
figurative_meaning_bn: প্রায় সমার্থক যুগ্মশব্দ; সহায় ও সম্বল
figurative_meaning_en: A nearly synonymous compound word; aid and support
example_sentences_in_english: You all are now my pillar of strength.
note: This idiom is a common compound expression in Bengali, emphasizing reliance on inner or external strength.
